text: Chilly. There are a few chilly mornings, even in Rio.
Freezing. I'm freezing, and there's hardly any sun today.
Fog. There's so much fog that I can't see the street.
Humid. Rio is humid, and there is plenty of sun.
Layers. You need plenty of layers in July.
Hoodie. I have only a few hoodies, and I wear them all.
Heater. There is little heat in my room without the heater.
Breeze. There is a little breeze by the beach.
Ugh, it's so chilly today. Was it like this in Rio?
No way. In Rio there are hardly any cold days, even in July.
Really? So what did you wear in winter?
Just a hoodie. There were only a few chilly mornings.
Here you need plenty of layers. And our heater is on all night!
I know. And there's so little sun that I miss the beach.
Well, there are a few sunny days next week. Let's go to the park!
Good idea. But I'm taking two hoodies, just in case.

Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm at the bus stop and I'm freezing. There's so much fog that I can hardly see the street. I have a few minutes before the bus, so I'm calling you. There are hardly any warm days left, and I have only one hoodie! Can I borrow a few layers for the school trip? Oh, and bring a little hot chocolate if you can. There's plenty of space in my bag!
